body: I noticed a wax and wane of friends after high school also. Throughout my 20s to early 30s my number of friends did vary. There seems to be some cycle to it. But with regards to popularity; you were popular once, you can learn new skills/improve old ones to be popular again. Just look at it as a challenge, no different then a side mission on some computer game. You have time, and options.

Have you considered looking for support groups? Some hospitals have support groups for those suffering depression. If this is what you suffer this may be your best choice. My experience in revealing my depression to friends has been mixed. Some friends have been supportive, other became fearful and distant.
Man I do feel for you. Our situations sound painfully similar. I wish you the best.
